title: Object storage lifecycle rules
text: AcmeCloud object storage supports lifecycle rules that automatically move objects to the Archive tier after a configurable number of days. Archived objects cost about 80 percent less to store but take up to 12 hours to restore.

title: Autoscaling
text: Autoscaling groups add or remove virtual machines based on CPU utilization. The default policy scales out when average CPU stays above 70 percent for five minutes and scales in below 30 percent.

title: Backup retention
text: Daily database snapshots are kept for 35 days by default. Point-in-time recovery lets you restore a database to any second within the last 7 days.

title: API rate limits
text: The AcmeCloud API allows 600 requests per minute per project. Requests above the limit receive HTTP status 429 and should be retried with exponential backoff.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Administrators can require two-factor authentication for every member of an organization. Supported second factors are authenticator apps and hardware security keys; SMS codes are not supported.

title: Private networking
text: Virtual private networks isolate your resources from the public internet. Traffic between subnets stays on the internal backbone and is never exposed to external routers.

title: Log retention
text: Application logs are retained for 30 days and can be exported to cold storage for long-term compliance. Log search supports filters on severity, service name and time range.

title: Support plans
text: Premium support guarantees a 15 minute response time for critical incidents, available around the clock. Basic support offers email help with a next-business-day response.

title: Annual leave policy
text: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per year. Up to five unused days can be carried over into the following year.

title: Sick leave policy
text: Employees may take up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for absences longer than three consecutive days.

title: Parental leave
text: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks. Leave can be taken any time within the first year after the birth or adoption.

title: Remote work policy
text: Employees may work remotely up to three days a week with manager approval. Remote workers must be reachable during core hours from 10:00 to 15:00.

title: Expense reimbursement
text: Business expenses must be submitted within 30 days with itemized receipts. Meals are reimbursed up to 60 dollars per day while traveling.

title: Performance reviews
text: Performance reviews take place twice a year, in June and December. Each review combines a self-assessment, peer feedback and a manager rating on a five-point scale.

title: Learning budget
text: Every employee has an annual learning budget of 1,200 dollars for courses, books and conferences. Unused budget does not roll over.

title: Onboarding
text: New hires receive a laptop on their first day and complete security training within two weeks. A buddy from the team guides them through the first month.

title: Japan entry requirements
text: Citizens of many countries can visit Japan for up to 90 days without a visa. A passport valid for the whole stay and proof of onward travel are required at the border.

title: Tokyo transit card
text: The Suica card works on trains, subways and buses across Tokyo and can also pay in convenience stores. It can be topped up at any station machine.

title: Altitude sickness
text: Altitude sickness can start above 2,500 meters. Climbing slowly, drinking water and resting on arrival help the body adjust.

title: Baggage allowance
text: Economy passengers may check one bag up to 23 kilograms. Overweight luggage is charged 15 euros per extra kilogram.

title: Travel insurance
text: Travel insurance covers medical emergencies, cancelled flights and lost luggage. Pre-existing conditions are usually excluded unless declared in advance.

title: Louvre visit
text: The Louvre is closed on Tuesdays. Tickets must be booked online for a fixed time slot, and the Mona Lisa is in Room 711.

title: Sourdough starter
text: A sourdough starter is fed equal parts flour and water every 12 hours at room temperature. It is ready to bake with when it doubles in size within six hours of feeding.

title: Cooking basmati rice
text: Basmati rice should be rinsed until the water runs clear, then cooked with one and a half parts water for 12 minutes. Let it rest covered for 5 minutes before fluffing.

title: Knife safety
text: Keep kitchen knives sharp because dull blades slip and cause more injuries. Cut on a stable board and curl your fingertips away from the blade.

title: Leftover food safety
text: Cooked leftovers should be refrigerated within two hours and eaten within four days. Reheat food until it reaches 74 degrees Celsius throughout.

title: Espresso recipe
text: A good espresso uses 18 grams of ground coffee and takes about 27 seconds to produce 36 grams of liquid. Water temperature should be near 93 degrees Celsius.

title: Baking soda vs powder
text: Baking soda needs an acidic ingredient such as buttermilk or lemon juice to make dough rise, while baking powder already contains its own acid. Using the wrong one can leave a metallic taste.

title: Sleep hygiene
text: Adults generally need seven to nine hours of sleep. Keeping a regular schedule and avoiding screens before bed improves sleep quality.

title: Hydration
text: A common guideline is about two liters of water per day, more during exercise or hot weather. Pale yellow urine is a simple sign of good hydration.

title: Beginner running plan
text: Beginners can prepare for a 5 kilometer run in eight weeks by alternating walking and running three times a week. Rest days prevent injury.

title: Stretching
text: Dynamic stretching before exercise warms up muscles, while static stretching is best after workouts. Hold each static stretch for 30 seconds.

title: Protein intake
text: Active adults often aim for 1.2 to 2.0 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight. Good sources include eggs, beans, fish and dairy.

title: Savings account interest
text: The Acme Savings account pays 3.8 percent annual interest, calculated daily and paid monthly. There is no minimum balance.

title: Credit card late fees
text: Late payments incur a fee of 25 dollars, and the penalty interest rate rises to 29.9 percent. Setting up automatic payments avoids missed due dates.

title: International wire transfer
text: International wire transfers cost 30 dollars and usually arrive within two business days. A SWIFT code and the recipient's IBAN are required.

title: Budgeting rule
text: The 50/30/20 rule suggests spending 50 percent of income on needs, 30 percent on wants and saving 20 percent.

title: Diversification
text: Diversification spreads investments across many assets so that one poor performer does not ruin the portfolio. Index funds provide broad diversification at low cost.

title: Emergency fund
text: An emergency fund should cover three to six months of living expenses and be kept in an easily accessible account.

title: Slow Wi-Fi
text: If the Wi-Fi is slow, restart the router, move closer to it and check for interference from microwave ovens. Switching to the 5 GHz band reduces congestion.

title: Phone battery care
text: Lithium-ion batteries last longer when kept between 20 and 80 percent charge. Avoid leaving the phone in hot cars, since heat accelerates aging.

title: Password managers
text: A password manager generates and stores a unique long password for each account. Protect it with a strong master password and two-factor authentication.

title: 3-2-1 backup rule
text: The 3-2-1 backup rule keeps three copies of data on two different media with one copy stored off-site.

title: Printer offline
text: When a printer shows offline, check that it is powered on and connected to the same network, then remove and re-add it in system settings.

title: Bluetooth pairing
text: To pair Bluetooth headphones, hold the power button for five seconds until the light blinks blue, then select the device from the phone's Bluetooth menu.

title: Photosynthesis
text: Plants convert sunlight, water and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen through photosynthesis. The process takes place in chloroplasts, which contain the pigment chlorophyll.

title: Plate tectonics
text: Earth's crust is divided into plates that move a few centimeters per year. Earthquakes and volcanoes cluster along the boundaries where plates collide or slide past each other.

title: Water cycle
text: Water evaporates from oceans, condenses into clouds and returns as precipitation. Rivers carry runoff back to the sea.

title: Newton's second law
text: Newton's second law states that force equals mass times acceleration. A heavier object therefore needs a larger force to speed up at the same rate.

title: DNA structure
text: DNA stores genetic information in a double helix made of four bases: adenine, thymine, guanine and cytosine. Adenine pairs with thymine and guanine pairs with cytosine.

title: Black holes
text: A black hole is a region where gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape beyond the event horizon.

title: How vaccines work
text: Vaccines train the immune system to recognize a pathogen by presenting a harmless piece or weakened form of it. If the real pathogen appears later, the body responds faster.

title: Overfitting
text: Overfitting happens when a model memorizes training data and performs poorly on new data. Regularization and more training examples reduce it.

title: Text embeddings
text: An embedding maps text to a vector so that similar meanings lie close together. Cosine similarity compares the angle between two vectors.

title: Inflation
text: Inflation is the rate at which prices rise, reducing purchasing power. Central banks often raise interest rates to slow it down.

title: Greenhouse effect
text: Greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide and methane trap heat in the atmosphere. Burning fossil fuels is the largest source of added carbon dioxide.

title: Moon phases
text: The Moon completes a cycle of phases every 29.5 days as the sunlit portion visible from Earth changes. A full moon occurs when Earth lies between the Sun and Moon.

title: Error E1001
text: Error E1001 means the storage quota was exceeded. Resolution: delete old snapshots or buy more storage.

title: Error E1002
text: Error E1002 means the API key is invalid. Resolution: create a new key in the console.

title: Error E2040
text: Error E2040 means the request timed out. Resolution: retry after a few seconds.

title: Error E2041
text: Error E2041 means the domain name could not be resolved. Resolution: check the DNS settings.

title: Error E3007
text: Error E3007 means the TLS certificate has expired. Resolution: renew the certificate.

title: Error E3008
text: Error E3008 means the TLS certificate does not match the host name. Resolution: issue a certificate for the correct name.

title: Error E4012
text: Error E4012 means the payment was declined by the bank. Resolution: update the billing card or contact your bank.

title: Error E4013
text: Error E4013 means the saved card has expired. Resolution: add a new card in billing settings.

title: Error E5503
text: Error E5503 means the service is temporarily unavailable. Resolution: wait and check the status page.

title: Error E5504
text: Error E5504 means the region is under maintenance. Resolution: switch to another region.

title: Error E6001
text: Error E6001 means the file is larger than the upload limit. Resolution: split the file into smaller parts.

title: Error E6002
text: Error E6002 means the file type is not allowed. Resolution: convert the file to a supported format.
